          if <(effect) = [blast]> then
            broadcast (flash v)
            make (1) [shock] :: custom
            make (1) [fireball] :: custom
            make (12) [spark] :: custom
          else
            if <(effect) = [quake]> then
              broadcast (shake v)
              make (1) [shock] :: custom
              make (5) [smoke] :: custom
              make (6) [chunk] :: custom
            else
              if <(effect) = [mega]> then
                broadcast (flash v)
                broadcast (shake v)
                make (1) [shock] :: custom
                make (1) [fireball] :: custom
                make (16) [spark] :: custom
                make (16) [ember] :: custom
                make (6) [smoke] :: custom
                make (8) [chunk] :: custom
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
